mapper.select: SELECT WS_ROLE FROM WS_MEMBERS WHERE WS_ID = #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND EVENT_TYPE = 'WS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS ( HLD_ID, HLD_DATE, HLD_NAME, IS_REST, COUNTRY ) VALUES ( SEQ_HLD_ID.NEXTVAL, TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYYMMDD'), #{title}, 'Y', 'KR' )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NATIONAL_HOLIDAYS WHERE TO_CHAR(HLD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') = #{hldDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENTS ( EVENT_ID, PROJ_ID, WS_ID, TITLE, START_DT, END_DT, EVENT_TYPE, USER_ID, COLOR ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{projId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{wsId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{title}, TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{itemType}, #{userId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{color, jdbcType=VARCHAR} /* 👈 이 부분에 VARCHAR 타입을 명시하세요! */ )
mapper.select: SELECT e.*, u.USER_NAME FROM EVENTS e JOIN USERS u ON e.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE e.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND (e.IS_PRIVATE = 'N' OR e.USER_ID = #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENTS SET START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE EVENT_ID = #{id}
UPDATE EVENTS SET TITLE = #{title}, START_DT = TO_DATE(#{startDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), END_DT = TO_DATE(#{endDt}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') WHERE EVENT_ID = #{id}
